name: Commercial Kitchen Allergen Control SOP & Checklist
primary_keyword: allergen control sop commercial kitchen uk
search_intent: Hospitality managers, head chefs, and food business operators needing a standardized, compliant Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) to prevent allergen cross-contact, enforce Natasha's Law compliance, and satisfy EHO inspection standards.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Official guidance documents and PDF leaflets; lacks interactive digital checklists.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Course guide explaining allergen procedures; static text without kitchen log exports.

competitors.name: CIEH
competitors.features: Policy papers and training links; non-operational kitchen tools.

competitors.name: Safer Food Scores
competitors.features: Consultancy templates; static Word/PDF downloads with sales pitch.

competitors.name: FoodDocs
competitors.features: Paywalled compliance software ($79/mo) requiring account registration.

competitors_lack: No interactive digital audit checklist with pass/fail/pending status tracking
No operational 7-stage SOP sequence covering intake, storage, purple kit, and pass handover
No chemical sanitiser contact time stopwatch for allergen spill decontamination
No instant CSV export and printable high-contrast A4 supervisor sign-off sheet
our_differentiators: Interactive commercial allergen SOP tool with pre-loaded statutory compliance tasks
Full alignment with Natasha's Law (FIR 2021) and Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011
Integrated BS EN 1276 chemical contact stopwatch (30s/60s/120s)
Print-ready A4 kitchen compliance audit sheet with lead chef verification
